# Command and option reference

Captured from every public command's real `--help` with an empty HOME/environment.
Installer-only server commands are included separately; do not invoke them manually.

## hx-server

```text
Usage: hx-server [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  migrate
  backup     Snapshot both databases and published blobs while the server stays online
  restore    Verify a backup and restore it into an absent or empty state directory
  doctor     Check state privacy/schema and provider readiness without calling a model
  status     Read schema compatibility and the number of live interpret leases
  serve
  token
  pair       Print a single-use pairing link, valid for 15 minutes
  setup      Set up this computer: pair the Mac app, guide the few steps only you can do (macOS permissions, model sign-in), then open the dashboard signed in. Safe to run again; it only shows what is left
  compile
  interpret
  gc         Disabled: deleting old media is not yet safe for referenced evidence
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
```

## hx-server upgrade-guard

```text
Hold the service worker idle throughout an installer lifecycle

Usage: hx-server upgrade-guard [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>...

Arguments:
  <COMMAND>...

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## hx-server upgrade-recover


## hx-server doctor

```text
Check state privacy/schema and provider readiness without calling a model

Usage: hx-server doctor [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
      --state-only             Check only state/schema/privacy; provider login may still be missing
      --allow-older-schema     Installer preflight: accept missing migrations, never changed/newer ones
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## hx-server token

```text
Usage: hx-server token [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list    List token IDs, names, scopes, prefixes and revocation state (no secrets)
  revoke  Revoke the full token ID printed by token list. Effective next request
  create
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## hx-server pair

```text
Print a single-use pairing link, valid for 15 minutes

Usage: hx-server pair [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>
       hx-server pair <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list    List code hash IDs and metadata, never the pairing secrets
  revoke  Revoke a full code ID from pair list. Does not revoke an issued token
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
      --url <URL>              [default: http://127.0.0.1:7377]
      --name <NAME>
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## hx-server setup

```text
Set up this computer: pair the Mac app, guide the few steps only you can do (macOS permissions, model sign-in), then open the dashboard signed in. Safe to run again; it only shows what is left

Usage: hx-server setup [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          One JSON line per change for an agent; `say` is what to tell the person
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Local state folder; required for every command except doctor and version [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
      --no-open
          Do not open the dashboard at the end
      --timeout-minutes <TIMEOUT_MINUTES>
          Stop waiting after this many minutes; the next run continues [default: 20]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## hx-move

```text
Verify and copy frozen Postgres history into a new SQLite state directory

Usage: hx-move [OPTIONS] --postgres-url <POSTGRES_URL> --source-data-dir <SOURCE_DATA_DIR> --state-dir <STATE_DIR>

Options:
      --postgres-url <POSTGRES_URL>
          [env: HX_MOVE_POSTGRES_URL]
      --source-data-dir <SOURCE_DATA_DIR>
          Legacy data directory containing blobs/ (read only)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Must be absent or empty. No default [env: HX_STATE_DIR=]
      --verify-all-blobs
          Compatibility flag: every published blob is always fully hashed
      --allow-empty
          Acknowledge an intentionally empty source database
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## hx-connector-apple-bridge

```text
Usage: hx-connector-apple-bridge [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  describe
  sync
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --server <SERVER>            [env: HX_SERVER=]
      --token <TOKEN>              [env: HX_TOKEN]
      --instance <INSTANCE>        [env: HX_INSTANCE=]
      --source <SOURCE>            Override the source database, directory, or Apple Bridge base URL [env: HX_SOURCE=]
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
      --root <ROOT>                Git discovery roots; repeat for multiple roots
      --depth <DEPTH>              [default: 3]
      --apple-token <APPLE_TOKEN>  [env: HX_APPLE_TOKEN]
  -h, --help                       Print help
```
